body.prompt: At the same evening bus stop, the same little girl from the reference images (black bob, cream coat, no scarf now) stands with her back half turned toward us, her plain yellow backpack on her back, waving toward warm headlights of an approaching bus in the distance. The magpie flies down behind her with wings spread and gently sets a tiny brown parcel tied with red string and a small red heart tag on top of her backpack. Golden ginkgo leaves drifting. The magpie is exactly the character in the magpie reference image: a small round chibi magpie with a glossy black head, cream-white face and belly, big shiny dark-brown eyes, short black beak, dark navy-blue wings, a red knotted neckerchief and a small brown leather satchel. It does NOT hold a microphone. It is small, about the size of a sparrow compared with the people. Style: handcrafted 3D miniature diorama photographed with a macro lens, tilt-shift, shallow depth of field, soft cinematic light, felt, clay, paper and wood textures with tiny hand-painted details, gentle film grain, warm nostalgic color grade, clay figurines with soft rounded faces and deeply emotional Pixar-like expressions, not photorealistic. Vertical 9:16 frame, main subject in the middle of the frame, a calm uncluttered area in the top fifth of the frame. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no hangul, no logos, no labels, no brand names, no watermark anywhere.
